description: A passive infrared motion sensor with a digital output.
how_to_use: Three header pins in a row, left to right with the dome up: VCC, OUT, GND. Power it from 5V and GND (it needs about 4.5 V or more). While powered, OUT is actively driven: about 3.3 V (reads HIGH on a 5 V Arduino) while it sees motion, 0 V while all is still — so the Arduino pin reading it needs no pull-up or pull-down resistor; read it with digitalRead() on a pin set to INPUT. OUT can also drive an LED directly through a resistor. The real module holds OUT high for a few seconds after the motion stops (set by its orange trimpot).

pins.OUT: the output: HIGH while motion is sensed, LOW when still

plain.what: Notices when a person or animal moves in front of it (it senses body heat).
plain.how: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to an Arduino pin. OUT turns on (HIGH) while it sees movement — no extra resistor needed.

pins.OUT: turns on when it sees movement (to an Arduino pin)
